jobs.description: YES, a full time job mainly in the day shifts and a great salary of €15,60 per hour? Perfect! At Leen Bakker you pick and pack the nicest products for your house and garden. You’ll see it all!What we offer- Salary of €15,60 per hour (22+)- Work for at least 32 hours a week!- Travel allowances of €0,14 per kilometer- Grow further to deliverer or the assembly service!- Get a permanent contract very quickly!- A very great canteen!Who you areTo keep the warehouse running, it is important that you meet the following requirements as an orderpicker:- You are available full-time;- You can work in day shifts;- You are physically able to lift heavy furniture;- You speak Dutch or English;- You can work in Raamsdonksveer;- You have your own transportation.What will you doAs an orderpicker you work in one of the five distribution centers of Leen Bakker. You’re cruising the warehouse on your own in no time!Where will you workYou’ll work in the warehouse of one of the best home furnishing stores: Leen Bakker! It’s a big warehouse with FIVE locations! Luckily, they’re all in the same business park in Raamsdonksveer. Nice and easy, right?! Every location has its own specialty. One for picking and packing, one for returns and one for cutting carpets and rugs! So, where will you work as an orderpicker? Or... everywhere!At Leen Bakker you will definitely work with a small and close team. AND THE CANTEEN?! Restaurant worthy. Really! It's full of items of Leen Bakker and a delicious catering!Now that’s recharging in your break, right
